note: An institution without an entry has no reviewed body-specific rulemaking-petition procedure indexed here. Absence records missing evidence, never a finding that petitioning that institution is legally unavailable. Directory membership, organizational form and a related body's procedure never supply an entry.

small-business-services.receiving_body: Office of the General Counsel, NYC Department of Small Business Services
small-business-services.procedure_title: Petitions for Agency Rulemaking (66 RCNY ch. 20)
small-business-services.destination_statement: Petitions go to the DSBS Office of the General Counsel, at the address the rule directs you to on the DSBS website.
small-business-services.response_statement: Within 60 days of receiving a petition in proper form, DSBS must either deny it in writing with its reasons, or approve it in writing and state the date by which it will begin rulemaking.
